_comment: TripFlare default configuration. Copy to config.json (next to tripflare.py) and edit; config.json wins over this file. JSON has no comments, so explanatory fields are prefixed with underscore.
_language: UI and AI report language: 'auto' (follow OS locale), 'en' (English), or 'zh' (Simplified Chinese).
_interval_seconds: Seconds between periodic scan rounds in daemon mode (60-600 recommended).
_realtime_watch: Enable Win32 ReadDirectoryChangesW instant tripwire on Startup / Downloads / Desktop / Temp.
_heavy_interval_rounds: Services / scheduled tasks / IFEO / StartupApproved are diffed every N rounds (heavy snapshot).
_sha1_max_bytes: SHA1 is computed only for NEW files, and skipped above this size (50 MB).
_max_dir_entries: Directories with more entries than this are skipped (add game/cache dirs to exclude_dirs).
_system_noise_filter: Suppress noisy OS/background churn (DISM Temp servicing, Microsoft-signed runtime DLLs in Temp, per-user LUID services, browser auto-update churn, ephemeral .tmp.js / PS policy probes).

allowlist._comment: Manage with: tripflare.py allow <path-or-signer> or via the console UI.

_exclude_dirs: Absolute paths (env vars allowed) skipped by the file watcher, e.g. "D:\\Games".
_watch_dirs: null = built-in defaults: Startup x2 (depth 2), ProgramData (2), Downloads/Desktop (3), AppData Roaming/Local (2), Temp (1), user profile root (1). Override as [[path, depth], ...].

ai._comment: Three modes: 'recommend' (default, zero tokens until user clicks AI Review), 'patrol' (automatic on high alerts + timer), 'off' (local heuristics only).
ai._provider: 'auto' | 'ollama' | 'openai' | 'cli'. Auto checks api_key -> CLI tool -> local Ollama.
ai._api_base: Optional base URL (defaults: http://127.0.0.1:11434 for Ollama, https://api.openai.com/v1 for OpenAI-compatible APIs).
ai._api_key: Optional API key for OpenAI-compatible endpoints (or set TRIPFLARE_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY env var).
ai._model: Model name (optional: auto-detects first local model for Ollama; defaults to gpt-4o-mini for OpenAI).
ai._backend_path: Used when provider is 'cli' (or auto fallback): 'auto' detects kimi.exe, or point to any CLI accepting '<bin> -p "prompt"'.
ai._max_calls_per_day: Daily AI-call circuit breaker (patrol mode). Manual ai-review is never blocked.
ai._patrol_interval_minutes: patrol mode: run one routine patrol this often, even without alerts.
ai._patrol_immediate_cooldown_minutes: patrol mode: high alerts trigger an immediate patrol at most once per cooldown window (alerts merge inside the window).

patrol._allow_auto_quarantine: DANGEROUS. When true the patrol prompt permits moving high-confidence malware into quarantine. Default false: the AI is strictly read-only and only reports.

notify._balloon: Fallback balloon on high alerts for tray-less users (non-blocking PowerShell NotifyIcon). Set false when tripflare_tray owns notifications.
notify._desktop_bat: DEPRECATED - the tray agent replaced the desktop bat.
